## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in Inflect.

## Reproduction

Provide the exact command, model revision, prompt set, and environment.

## Evidence

- [ ] Public examples still compile.
- [ ] Existing inference behavior is preserved or the change is documented.
- [ ] Audio claims include matched prompts and listening notes.
- [ ] Metric claims include raw outputs and protocol details.
- [ ] No weights, generated corpora, private audio, credentials, or local paths are committed.

## Release impact

List documentation, model-package, compatibility, or benchmark changes.
